final: SELECT e.event_id, COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS attendance_records, COUNT(a.link_to_member) * 1.0 / t.total AS attendance_share FROM event AS e LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM attendance) AS t WHERE t.total > 0 GROUP BY e.event_id, t.total ORDER BY attendance_share DESC, e.event_id LIMIT 10
